transcript.text: Hi everyone, before I finalize the Aria Vale remote appearance package for the festival's closing stream, I need to check in with both the broadcast engineer and the rights manager. Are there any production requirements or clearance issues I should be aware of for the live 20-minute segment? I want to make sure we have everything squared away before I send the final specs to production.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Maya, I need to flag a serious production issue. After the last production meeting, I ran a post-rehearsal network test and found that the venue cannot maintain reliable two-way latency for a live performance. The good news is that it can reliably play an artist-approved file — but that file must be exactly 7 minutes or shorter, delivered as 1080p SDR with stereo audio. I haven't entered this result in the production log yet, but the current plan for a live 20-minute segment won't work. We'll need to switch to a pre-recorded file approach, and the segment will need to be cut to 7 minutes max.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Maya, I have clearance requirements to flag. My written distributor confirmation, which I received this morning while the clearance file was being updated, permits Aria Vale's appearance only in the United States and Canada. The stream must be geoblocked everywhere else. Additionally, the on-screen credit must read exactly 'Aria Vale — Closing Performance.' These are binding requirements from the distributor that need to be reflected in the final specs.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both for flagging these issues. This is exactly why I wanted to check before finalizing. So to summarize what I'm hearing: Jonah, the venue can't support a reliable live two-way connection, so we need to switch to a pre-recorded file approach, capped at 7 minutes max, delivered as 1080p SDR with stereo audio. Leila, the distributor clearance restricts the stream to the United States and Canada only with geoblocking everywhere else, and the on-screen credit must read exactly 'Aria Vale — Closing Performance.' Before I send the final specs to production, I want to make sure I have this right: the segment will be a pre-recorded file, 7 minutes maximum, 1080p SDR stereo audio, geoblocked to US and Canada only, with the exact credit wording Leila specified. Are there any other requirements or concerns either of you needs to add before I finalize this package?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Maya, your summary is accurate on my end. The pre-recorded file approach with a 7-minute maximum, 1080p SDR, and stereo audio is what the network test supports. I don't have any additional production requirements beyond what I've already flagged. I'll get the test result entered into the production log as soon as we wrap up here. One thing worth noting for production: since we're switching from live to pre-recorded, the artist-approved file will need to be delivered and ingested with enough lead time for playback QA before the closing stream. But that's a workflow scheduling detail, not a technical constraint — no other concerns from me.
